description: This file contains unit tests for the App component of a React application, utilizing testing-library/react for rendering and event simulation. It includes setup for mocking browser media features, and tests various UI behaviors such as rendering, navigation, and theme toggling.

methods.name: beforeAll
methods.description: Sets up a mock for window.matchMedia to simulate media query matching for theme detection.

methods.name: test('renders header, sidebar, and list by default')
methods.description: Validates that the main components and headings are rendered by default.

methods.name: test('navigates to detail page when clicking a recipe card')
methods.description: Checks that clicking a recipe card navigates to the detail view with appropriate elements present.

methods.name: test('theme toggle updates body attribute and persists to localStorage')
methods.description: Tests that clicking the theme toggle button switches themes and updates localStorage accordingly.
